51372043.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human full-length N-terminal His6-tagged Bcl2 (2 to 206 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli S12 extract by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: To assay the Kd values of BH3 peptides toward different Bcl-2 variants, Bcl-xl and Mcl-1, the BH3 peptide was labeled at the N-terminus with 6-carboxyfluorescein succinimidyl ester (FAM) as the fluorescent tag. FAM-BH3 peptide was dissolved to 10 μM in the assay buffer (100 mM potassium phosphate, pH = 7.5; 100 μg/mL bovine γ globulin; 0.02% sodium azide), and 5 μL of gradient concentrations of the Bcl-2 protein solution was added. After 30 min incubation, the polarization values were measured using a Synergy Max MS Detection System in a black 96-well plate at an excitation wavelength of 485 nm and an emission wavelength of 530 nm. The IC50 value was determined from the saturation binding curve to give the Kd value. For the competitive binding assay for S1-6-series compounds, FAM-Bim peptide (10 nM) and different Bcl-2 variants protein (60 nM/Bcl-xl (60 nM)/Mcl-1 (55 nM)) were preincubated in the FP assay buffer. Then, compounds were added in serial dilutions, and the polarization values were measured by the same means. The IC50 value was determined from the competitive binding curve, and the Ki values were calculated using the equation K_i = IC_{50}/([L]_{50}/K_d + [P]_0/K_d + 1) IC50, the concentration of the free inhibitor at 50% inhibition; [L]50, the concentration of the free labeled ligand at 50% inhibition; and [P]0, the concentration of the free protein at 0% inhibition. To assay the Kd values of ABT-199 or ABT-263 toward different Bcl-2 variants, isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed using a high-precision iTC200 (Microcal LLC, Northampton, MA). In this experiment, the heat of the reaction was obtained by making 16 injections (2.4 μL each) of the ligand (final concentration in the syringe of 200 μM in 20 mM Tris, 150 mM NaCl, and 5% DMSO, pH 7.8) into the reaction cell that contained Bcl-2 in the same buffer (final protein concentration of 20 μM). The experiments were carried out at 25 °C and a stirring speed of 500 rpm. Then, the resultant titration data were fitted in Origin 7.5 (Microcal Software Inc., Northampton, MA). All sample data obtained after data corrections were analyzed to fit to a one-site model. For the control experiment, the sample cell was filled with the assay buffer and the compound solution was added.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. In vitro and in vivo dephosphorylation assay of Bcl-2 characterized that the arginine–phosphate interactions prevent the phosphorylation sites from dephosphorylation. (a) In vitro dephosphorylation assay of prephosphorylated pBcl-2-206 or pBcl-2R106A/R109A in phosphatase assay buffer with or without PP2A-C. (b) The level of pBcl-2(Ser70) in endogenous Bcl-2-silenced HL-60 after Bcl-2-206 and Bcl-2R106A/R109A transfection. Protein levels were determined by immunoblotting using specific antibodies, and figures represent the results from n = 3 independent samples.
